results.title: Congrats on First Chair
results.overview: Desperate to make memories during the last few months of high school, Emma and her best friend Matt go to the beach where they kiss despite him having a girlfriend.

results.title: Olena Pchilka. I'll Share My Words With You
results.overview: Olha Drahomanova Kosach (a.k.a. Olena Pchilka) is best remembered today as the mother of Lesya Ukrainka, one of Ukrainian literature's most celebrated authors. But, despite being overshadowed in every way by her daughter, during her lifetime, her actions have secretly shaped the quest for Ukrainian cultural and linguistic autonomy in more ways. Her life story isn't just a story of a single individual, nor even her her family. It's a story about a nation's continous search for identity in the face of all odds.

results.title: Guesthouse
results.overview: In southwest China, Xiuzhi navigates her migrant-worker guesthouse alone with ease while raising three young daughters—until a baby boy disrupts this fragile balance.

results.title: RUNNER
results.overview: A young drug dealer has to evade two police officers whilst getting ready to have dinner with his girlfriend's parents for the first time

results.title: Pacific Islands
results.overview: A middle-aged woman arrives at a hotel where important events from her past took place. The visit takes an unexpected turn when she meets a young man.

results.title: Picasso's Mermaid
results.overview: Mary accidentally discovers a mermaid drawn on the wall of her small apartment in Warsaw. It turns out it was drawn by Pablo Picasso during his visit in 1948! She's thrilled, but she doesn't realize the mermaid will turn her life upside down.

results.title: Cypress Under the Moon
results.overview: Atsushi Egawa is a 32-year-old aspiring novelist who works part-time and complains that the world is ugly and people are cruel. When his optimistic girlfriend finally leaves him, Egawa sets out to prove that society is at fault—and that winning her back will follow. His stubborn, illogical quest brings him into contact with others and forces him to confront his heartbreak and himself.

results.title: Kicking it Up with the Tiki Takas
results.original_title: Kicking it Up with the Tiki Takas
results.overview: A local football team defines what it takes to win. Through their ups and downs they train through the tension leading up to the most important game in the season.

results.title: Do You Understand Or Do I Have To Spell It Out For You?
results.overview: Madrid, Spring 1992. Pepe, owner of a Catalan tavern in Chueca, faces the worst streak of his life: his bar is in ruin, his wife leaves him and the debts drown him. When he thinks all is lost, his friends propose a twist as unexpected as brilliant: turn the tavern into a gay pub! What happens from there is an unstoppable succession of entanglements, crazy situations and endearing characters, in a politically incorrect comedy, current, and absolutely smarty.

results.title: The Hunt
results.overview: Detectives are picked off one by one from a seemingly unstoppable force.

results.title: Musical Hetalia ~World⭐︎Starts~
results.original_title: ミュージカル「ヘタリア〜World⭐︎Starts〜」

results.title: Winter Lions
results.overview: Opening with a tragic crime, whose perpetrator attempts to hide his tracks, including his relationship to people in power and organized crime. The father of the victim – his daughter – who thought he had left behind a life marked by violence, decides to seek justice on his own, crossing red lines from which there is no return. If there is anything more dangerous than a father defending his children, is a father who no longer has any children to defend.

results.title: Snared
results.overview: Join us on a journey around Auckland oceans and beaches, uncovering the impacts of fisheries on ocean ecosystems in New Zealand. Discover the balance we need to protect ocean life and appreciate the beauty of our marine life.

results.title: Paul and Greg and Amelia
results.overview: A novelist struggling with writer's block interviews his wealthy estranged college roommate and his wife, where an old secret threatens all of their safety.

results.title: Journey
results.overview: An artist runs out of paint days before an exhibition. Desperate for money, he decides to run a hustle: he swaps his brushes for a Bible and heads to the market, performing as a preacher. As he tries this new performance, his path crosses with a dancer.

results.title: Hide
results.overview: A reclusive hunter clashes with her ambitious son over whether or not to capitalize on a tragic, coveted  family heirloom.

results.title: Nocturne
results.overview: Utilizing the ‘glitch’ as a portal into hidden worlds, Nocturne explores the metaphors of nothingness embedded in darkness. It suggests that the indeterminate qualities of the unknown can provide revelations of wonder rather than existential dread, and that we can move through the unknown while also carrying it with us.

results.title: Ghosts: The Possession of Button House
results.original_title: Ghosts: The Possession of Button House
results.overview: It's a matter of life and death for Alison, Mike, Mia and the Ghosts.

results.title: Ziggy's Show: The Curse of Mariachi Bondage
results.original_title: El Show de Ziggy: La Maldición del Mariachi Bondage
results.overview: Ziggy, a rising influencer, is trying to increase her number of followers on social media by awakening the curse of an old song. Now a gloomy mariachi who makes people dance until they die is chasing Ziggy until he fulfills her dream of making her viral.
